# Control-response loss and recovery through retained joint relations

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> An observable read through a reduction is single-valued exactly where it agrees across what the reduction merges, so no map restores two different configurations it merges; a real-amplitude dephasing fragment is an instance, and retaining the joint state with a blank register permits exact reversal.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every reduction and observable: what the observable reads through the reduction is single-valued exactly where it agrees across what the reduction merges; on two configurations the reduction merges, a decoder right at both exists exactly when the observable agrees there, so no map restores two different configurations it merges. In the specified real-amplitude fragment, controlled X/Z order and complete dephasing preserve control branch weights while changing a fixed measurement response; the diagonal merges the coherent and degraded matrices, whose plus responses differ, so a diagonal-only decoder fails, and dephasing merges the prepared and coherent matrices, so no uniform inverse exists: both are instances. A reversible interaction with a blank register realizes the dephasing on reduction, and retaining the joint state permits exact reversal; along runs, dephasing is not lossless, and nothing read later restores where the prepared and coherent runs began.

Canonical source: [Dephasing.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Dephasing.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Integer amplitude and density numerators with explicit normalization; H, X, Z, coherent control, reduction and measurement are specified operations, not derived physical laws. Arbitrary integer matrices are not asserted to be physical states.
- The no-inverse result requires one map to restore both original preparations from their common reduced output alone. Joint reversal retains the initially blank register and control of the same joint operation.

A restricted algebraic instantiation of standard quantum operations with the control coordinate first. Matrix traces and shared response denominators are explicit. This is a state-interface calculation, not a verified implementation of the full higher-order switch or a laboratory run.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Fresh Lean 4.29.1 build: 27 theorems and 54 declaration audits. 44 reports empty; 10 use propext, three of those also Quot.sound. No custom postulates or final Classical.choice. Source-bound frozen receipt; author counterreview, no independent acceptance or new empirical result.

The checked fragment has real integer amplitudes, selected operations and one response. It proves neither causal nonseparability, arbitrary complex quantum behavior, physical implementation, universal irreversibility, ethical degeneration nor the universal zero-substantive-axiom foundation.

- The prepared, coherent and degraded matrices share diagonal (1,1) but have distinct plus responses. Prepared and coherent matrices dephase to the same matrix, blocking uniform recovery from that matrix alone.
